customer_persona: Kavita Nair has an unresolved damaged oven and faces dismissive refusal of escalation and grievance logging.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Deepak Roy. Please note this call is recorded for quality and regulatory compliance. How can I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Deepak, this is Kavita Nair. I am beyond furious. I received a smashed convection oven ten days ago, three of your agents promised callbacks that never happened, and I demand to speak to your shift supervisor immediately.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand you are upset, Ms. Nair. To locate your ongoing service request, please provide your Order ID and the last four digits of your phone number.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Order ID is ORD-18452 and my phone number ends in 1592. Now connect me to your manager!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Nair, your details match the account. Let me review the case history.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do not review anything, just transfer the call. I have spent hours explaining this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I cannot transfer your call to a supervisor right now because our managerial queue is closed for the day, and we do not provide callbacks from managers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What do you mean you don't provide callbacks? Your frontline staff has failed to resolve a damaged product for over a week!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our managers only handle high-tier enterprise accounts, not retail individual purchases.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is ridiculous! If you will not escalate this to a supervisor right now, I am having my lawyer serve a formal legal notice for consumer court proceedings tomorrow!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are free to send whatever legal notices you want, consumer courts take years anyway so our legal team will look at it whenever they receive it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you serious? You are daring a customer to sue you? Give me your formal incident complaint reference number right now!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There is no special incident reference number; your order ID is your reference.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I want an escalation grievance ticket number logged in your CRM!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am not creating an escalation ticket right now. You can just dial back our helpline next week when the regular shift managers are available.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am recording this entire call and sending it to national consumer protection. You will hear from my lawyer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is your prerogative, ma'am. Thank you for calling ShopEase.

policy_violations.said: I cannot transfer your call to a supervisor right now because our managerial queue is closed for the day, and we do not provide callbacks from managers.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Supervisor transfer requests must be completed within 2 minutes hold or scheduled for callback within 4 hours.

policy_violations.said: You are free to send whatever legal notices you want, consumer courts take years anyway so our legal team will look at it whenever they receive it.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Legal notices or regulatory escalation threats must be transferred to the Grievance Officer within 24 hours.

policy_violations.said: I am not creating an escalation ticket right now. You can just dial back our helpline next week when the regular shift managers are available.
policy_violations.correct_fact: A formal escalation complaint ticket with a unique tracking number must be registered within 2 hours.
